readout_other: novel object recognition; CA1 LFP, spikes
direction_notes: TUS of CA1 increased novel object exploration, relative LFP power in theta and gamma bands and theta-gamma coupling in PD and normal mice from day 4; effects returned toward baseline by day 14.
safety_notes: HE staining showed no damage except minor damage at the electrode implantation site.

timing.protocol_description: Fundamental frequency 1 MHz, 50000 cycles per pulse, PRF 1 Hz, duty cycle 5%, stimulation duration (SD) 50 ms. Each stimulation lasted 5 minutes then paused 5 minutes, 3 cycles in total (25 minutes), once daily for 7 days.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twelve healthy wild-type mice (C57BL/6, all male, 10 months old, Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd.) were used. Six C57BL/6J-TgN (α- synuclein A53T) ZLFILAS mice (all male, 10 months old; Beijing Huafukang Co., Ltd.) were included in the experiment.

flags.reason: Paper gives 'stimulation duration (SD)=50 ms' with 50000 cycles at 1 MHz, PRF 1 Hz and duty cycle 5%; taken as the pulse duration because 5%/1 Hz = 50 ms (resolved by arithmetic).
Value 300 s is the 5-minute stimulation block (3 blocks separated by 5-minute pauses), converted from the text.
'Maximum sound pressure' 0.51 MPa given without stating the domain; a COMSOL simulation is mentioned separately.
12 wild-type and 6 transgenic mice are stated; non-stimulated normal controls exist, so the number actually sonicated is not stated; group sizes of 6 per group are used in the results.
Whether LFP and behaviour were recorded during or after sonication on test days is not stated in the text.
Effects are on memory and LFP power; direction in terms of excitation or inhibition is not stated.
Non-stimulated normal mice served as the comparison group; no sham device arm described.
